title: Amazon Software Development Engineer (SDE) Off Campus Hiring 2025 & 2026 Batch
overview: Amazon is actively hiring Software Development Engineer (SDE) freshers for their core retail, payments, and AWS development teams across Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Chennai.
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon

Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, deploy, and maintain innovative software services and high-scale distributed systems.
  • Write robust, clean, and maintainable code in Java, C++, Python, or Go.
  • Collaborate with Senior Engineers, Product Managers, and UX Designers to deliver customer-facing features.
  • Participate in architectural reviews, code reviews, and automated CI/CD pipeline deployments.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Target Batches: 2025 & 2026 Passouts (and recent 2024 graduates).
  • Degree: BE / B.Tech (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related technical disciplines), MCA, M.Tech.
  • Academics: 60% or 6.5 CGPA and above throughout 10th, 12th, and Graduation.

Key Skills Required

  • Strong fundamentals in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Design (OOD).
  • Proficiency in at least one modern language: Java, C++, Python, or C#.
  • Understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, RESTful APIs, and basic Cloud computing concepts.

title: Datavail Junior SQL & Database Developer Off Campus Drive for Freshers
overview: Datavail is hosting an off-campus recruitment drive for Junior SQL Developers and Database Trainees to support enterprise cloud data infrastructure.
descriptionHtml:
About Datavail

Datavail is a global data management and cloud database solutions provider managing complex enterprise data systems worldwide.

Job Summary & Roles

  • Write, optimize, and debug SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and relational schemas.
  • Support database migration, index tuning, query performance analysis, and data backup operations.
  • Work with SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MySQL environments under senior DBA guidance.

Eligibility & Qualifications

  • Degree: BE / B.Tech (All Branches), BCA, MCA, B.Sc (Computer Science / IT).
  • Batch: 2024, 2025 & 2026 Batch Freshers.
  • Experience: 0 to 1 Year (Freshers welcome).

Required Technical Skills

  • Good hands-on understanding of SQL queries (Joins, Aggregations, Subqueries, Indexing).
  • Familiarity with Database Management Systems (DBMS) and ER modeling.
  • Problem-solving mindset and eagerness to learn enterprise DBA technologies.

title: Google Associate Cloud Engineer & Developer Trainee Off Campus Drive
overview: Google is recruiting early-career graduates for Associate Cloud Engineer and Technical Solutions Specialist positions across India.
descriptionHtml:
About Google Cloud

Google Cloud provides organizations with leading infrastructure, platform capabilities, and industry solutions with Google's cutting-edge technology.

Job Summary & Roles

  • Assist customers and developers in designing, building, and operating cloud solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Develop automated scripts, infrastructure templates, and cloud migration prototypes.
  • Work with Kubernetes, BigQuery, Compute Engine, IAM security, and Cloud Networking.

Eligibility

  • Batches: 2025 & 2026 Batch Freshers.
  • Degree: BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, or related engineering disciplines.
  • Criteria: Strong conceptual grasp of networking, operating systems (Linux), and Python/Go programming.

title: TCS Off-Campus Hiring Drive (Ninja & Digital Cadre) for Freshers
location: Pan India (Bangalore, Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad, Noida, Kolkata)
overview: TCS invites applications for its mass off-campus hiring drive across India for Ninja and Digital software developer trainee roles.
descriptionHtml:
About TCS

Tata Consultancy Services is an IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world's largest businesses for over 50 years.

Cadres & Packages

  • TCS Digital: ₹7.0 LPA to ₹7.2 LPA (Advanced coding and full stack development).
  • TCS Ninja: ₹3.6 LPA (Core application development and enterprise IT operations).

Eligibility

  • Batch: 2024 & 2025 Batch Graduates.
  • Courses: BE, B.Tech, MCA, M.Sc (Maths/Stats/CS/IT), BCA, B.Sc.
  • Academic Criteria: Minimum 60% or 6.0 CGPA throughout 10th, 12th, Diploma, and Graduation. Maximum 1 active backlog permitted at test time.

title: Deloitte Analyst Trainee & Technology Consulting Off Campus Drive
overview: Deloitte India is hiring early talent for Analyst Trainee positions in Technology, Risk & Financial Advisory, and Analytics.
descriptionHtml:
About Deloitte

Deloitte drives progress. Our firms around the world help clients become leaders wherever they choose to compete.

Job Summary & Roles

  • Work on enterprise analytics, business intelligence dashboards (PowerBI, Tableau), and cloud data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with global clients to solve business challenges through technology automation and AI workflows.
  • Participate in system testing, requirement gathering, and technical documentation.

Eligibility

  • Batches: 2024, 2025 & 2026 Batch Freshers.
  • Degree: BE/B.Tech (All Specializations), MCA, BCA, B.Sc (Data Science, CS, IT, Stats), Any Graduate with quantitative background.
  • Skills: Analytical thinking, SQL, Python/R fundamentals, Excel, and good communication skills.
